title: Since 2019
body: Habitify is my favorite tool. I’ve been a daily user since 2019 and still going strong. I recomend it to everyone who wants to start tracking pattern, change habits or to make new. I have loved it for 3 years now 👏 Bravo team Habitify 👏
author: G.G.Loga

title: Simple and easy, but essentially paid-only
body: Recently switched from Android and found this a great comparison to the Android-only HabitNow. However, locking the amount of habits to 3 in the free version essentially makes this a paid app, as I can't imagine having only 3 habits tracked.
author: Broork
